description: PlayerActivity.kt implements a media player screen that uses ExoPlayer to play workout videos, displaying an overlay with workout title, elapsed time, and calorie estimate. It manages player lifecycle and overlays updates.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages video playback of workout videos using ExoPlayer, including overlay UI updates for workout info and timer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates views, retrieves workout data, and sets up UI components.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Sets up the ExoPlayer instance, associates media, and starts playback.

methods.name: updateOverlay
methods.description: Updates the overlay UI with current playback position, elapsed time, and calorie estimate.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initialize media player when activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method to release media player resources when activity stops.
